fullPassage: The term minimalism gives a negative impression to some people who think that it is all about sacrificing valuable possessions. This insecurity naturally stems from their attachment to their possessions. It is difficult to distance oneself from something that has been around for quite some time. Being an emotional animal, human beings give meaning to the things around them. So, the question arising here is that if minimalism will hurt one's emotions, why become a minimalist? The answer is very simple; the assumption of the question is fundamentally wrong. Minimalism does not hurt emotions. You might feel a bit sad while getting rid of a useless item but sooner than later, this feeling will be overcome by the joy of clarity. Minimalists never argue that you should leave every convenience of the modern era. They are of the view that you only need to eliminate stuff that is unused or not going to be used in the near future.

questions.passage: The term minimalism gives a negative impression to some people who think that it is all about sacrificing valuable possessions. This insecurity naturally stems from their attachment to their possessions. It is difficult to distance oneself from something that ①<u>have</u> been around for quite some time. Being an emotional animal, human beings give meaning to the things around them. So, the question arising here is that if minimalism will hurt one's emotions, why ②<u>become</u> a minimalist? The answer is very simple; the assumption of the question is fundamentally wrong. Minimalism does not hurt emotions. You might feel a bit sad while ③<u>getting</u> rid of a useless item but sooner than later, this feeling will be overcome by the joy of clarity. Minimalists never ④<u>argue</u> that you should leave every convenience of the modern era. They are of the view that you only need to eliminate stuff that is unused or not going to be used in the near future.

det.korean: have → has: 선행사 something(단수)에 수일치

관계대명사절 안에서도 동사는 선행사의 수에 맞춰요.
① have → has: 'something that ___ been around' — 선행사 something이 단수이므로 has가 맞아요 ← 정답
② become: 'why become a minimalist' — 조동사 없이 쓰는 원형부정사 형태 정상
③ getting: 'while getting rid of' — 전치사/접속사 뒤 동명사 정상
④ argue: 'Minimalists never argue' — 주어(Minimalists)가 복수라 동사원형 정상
det.tip: 단수 선행사(something) + has
